ideas.pitch: A cyberpunk tactical puzzle game where players manipulate real-time audio waveforms to bypass security nodes.
ideas.title: Echoes of the Grid
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages tight mechanics and polished audio-visual feedback, which traditionally scores high with game jam judges.

ideas.pitch: A narrative puzzle platformer where reversing time changes the state of the environmental platforming elements dynamically.
ideas.title: Chronos Canvas
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a core mechanical twist that is easy to understand in a live demonstration but deep enough to keep players engaged.

ideas.pitch: An educational pixel-art management game simulating sustainable resource allocation for a futuristic smart campus.
ideas.title: Eco-Quest IIITN
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to university-hosted hackathon judges who value impactful educational themes paired with retro aesthetics.

ideas.pitch: A rogue-lite crawler featuring procedural dungeon rooms dynamically styled and populated based on player playstyles.
ideas.title: Dungeon Architect AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines traditional game jam tropes with procedural generation, showcasing clever engineering within a strict timeframe.

ideas.pitch: A fast-paced retro arcade mini-game collection built to test ultra-low input latency and responsive touch mechanics.
ideas.title: Reflex Arcade 64
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets nostalgia-driven judges with an instantly playable, highly polished arcade loop that runs smoothly in any browser.
